title: Prompt any spell and use it in a fully 3D world with multiplayer
author: VirtualJamesHarrison
selftext:
* Prompt any spell and use it in a 3D physics based world
* Full multiplayer support for up to 6 players with VoIP
* All made with ThreeJS and Colyseus

[https://spellwright.xyz/](https://spellwright.xyz/)

replies.author: odragora
replies.body: Theoretically you can ship the game with a tiny tool calling model like Gemma finetuned specifically for your game and running on device.

replies.author: tiffanytrashcan
replies.body:
This is what "tiny garden" did in the Google Edge playground AI app. Super basic proof of concept but it's a 270m model running on a phone.  
A 3/4b model would be perfect for this and run on almost anything. Most are so good I question how much fine-tuning would be needed. (Gemma4, the latest Qwen) or you could fine-tune a 0.8B model that would probably do quite well too- Easily run in a browser.
